notes: Happy USER_ACTIVITY: legacy row + ledger row + exactly one send.
Happy USER_PROPERTY routes to people_set, not track.
Legacy row reaches terminal PROCESSED after delivery.
Ledger claim happens even though the forward worker suppresses the send.
Blacklisted event: no legacy row, no ledger row, no send.
No identity at all: serializer rejects, nothing written, nothing sent.
anonymous_id-only event is valid and forwards.
Unsupported event_type: no send, pipeline does not wedge.
R1 (WRITE=T SEND=T fwd-send=F): legacy row + ledger row, one send from legacy.
2a (WRITE=T SEND=F fwd-send=T): legacy row still written as rollback trail, forward sends.
2a: legacy row is never updated - status stays at the PROCESSING default.
2b (WRITE=F): no legacy row at all, ledger row present, forward sends.
MIXPANEL_SEND_ENABLED=False: ledger claimed, zero sends.
Send disabled also suppresses profile creation - no userprofilestatus row.
Same event_id produced 3x: one ledger row, one send.
Same event_id produced 5x: legacy serializer rejects the duplicates too.
Three distinct event_ids: three sends.
Replay long after first success still yields no second send.
2b posture: ledger claim is the only dedupe gate, replay still sends once.
Long non-UUID event_id is accepted (column is varchar, not uuid).
Mixpanel 500: retried, so more than one HTTP attempt is made.
500 then 200: recovers, single ledger row, no duplicate delivery.
429 rate limit is retried (no classifier yet - documents current behaviour).
400 is ALSO retried today - will change when the error classifier lands.
Application-level failure body ({status:0}) is treated as a failure.
Response slower than MIXPANEL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT times out and retries.
2a + MIXPANEL_DEV_FAST_RETRY: 500 forever exhausts the ladder and parks in the DLQ.
Legacy failure marks the legacy row ERROR on the first attempt (before any retry fires); ledger row is unaffected.
20 concurrent produces of the SAME event_id: UNIQUE race yields exactly one send.
50 distinct events concurrently: all 50 delivered.
200 distinct events sequentially: throughput / soak.
Concurrency against a 500ms-slow Mixpanel: no cascading failure.
10 concurrent blacklisted events: nothing written, nothing sent.
2b posture under 30 concurrent distinct events: ledger-only path holds up.
Kafka unreachable for the forward producer: R1 legacy still delivers.
Platform topic unset: produce fails at the call site, legacy unaffected.
Mixpanel connection refused (no scenario seeded -> mock 404s): retried, not crashed.
2a + Kafka down: failure is NOT swallowed - event does not silently vanish.
